summary.zh-CN: 为摸清一个领域的边界与缺口而做的图谱式梳理，重图表化而不是效果合并。
summary.en: Maps the boundaries and gaps of a field; charting matters more than pooling effects.

whenToUse.zh-CN: 想知道某领域有哪些类型的研究、概念如何界定
whenToUse.en: The aim is to see what kinds of studies exist and how concepts are defined

whenToUse.zh-CN: 文献异质，无法合并为一个效果结论
whenToUse.en: The literature is too heterogeneous to pool

whenToUse.zh-CN: 为后续系统综述确定范围与问题
whenToUse.en: A systematic review will follow and needs scoping first

focus.zh-CN: 界定概念与映射目的，说明为什么采用范围综述而不是系统综述。
focus.en: Define the concepts and the mapping objective, and why scoping rather than systematic review.

focus.zh-CN: 记录纳入排除标准、信息来源、检索、证据来源选择与图表化过程；说明是否做了质量评价及理由。
focus.en: Record eligibility, sources, search, selection and the charting process; state whether quality appraisal was done and why.

focus.zh-CN: 按研究特征与主题制图，用表格与流程图呈现分布；不合并效应量。
focus.en: Chart by study characteristics and themes with tables and a flow diagram; do not pool effects.

focus.zh-CN: 总结研究分布、缺口与限制；不擅自推断干预效果。
focus.en: Summarise the distribution, gaps and limitations; infer no intervention effects.

description.zh-CN: 附录（图表化模板、检索式）

methodNotes.zh-CN: PRISMA-ScR 为 20 项必备加 2 项可选；范围综述通常不做偏倚风险评估、不合并效应量，但检索与筛选流程仍须报告。
methodNotes.en: PRISMA-ScR has 20 required and 2 optional items; scoping reviews normally skip risk-of-bias and pooling but still report search and selection.
